metadata.description: Finite disk crop of a regular octagonal model set from a rank-four lattice; independently, the unfiltered four-bit cube under the same projection.
metadata.phasonConvention: Translate the centered baseWindow by (windowShift[0] + phasonX, windowShift[1]); retain a candidate when its internal point lies inside.
metadata.bitConvention: bits[j] = (id >> j) & 1; label lists x0,x1,x2,x3 left to right, least significant bit first
metadata.satAdjacency: One Boolean bit flip; booleanEdges records the 32 cube edges.
metadata.warning: Window membership is illustrative for SAT vertices. No SAT assignments are filtered out.
